description: The inputs a call passed did not satisfy the target's declared input contract.

data.description: Where the refusal lies in the value, or null when it locates nothing.

issues.description: Where in the value each refusal is, never quoting the value.

pointer.description: The refused value's place, as a JSON Pointer.

keyword.description: What it violated, in the issue vocabulary (`required`, `format`, `invalid`, …).

code.description: The value type's own code, for a value of a type with members that does not build.
